summary: Join our AI-Driven Insurance Innovation & Data Intelligence Training to master essential skills and leverage data for impactful decision-making in insurance.
lede: AI-driven insurance innovation and data intelligence help insurance professionals turn complex business challenges into practical, evidence-based decisions. This course shows how to apply AI and data across product design, pricing, underwriting, claims, risk, fraud detection, and customer engagement. You will learn to frame insurance challenges as data problems, assess models and outputs, interpret dashboards, and collaborate with data and technology teams. The course also helps you recognise biased models, unreliable data, and impractical experiments before they prevent useful solutions from reaching production.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly make or influence insurance decisions and need to understand AI and data intelligence.
audience: Customer experience and digital channels managers
modules: AI and Data Intelligence in Modern Insurance
AI Use Cases in Underwriting and Pricing
AI in Claims Management and Fraud Detection
Telematics, IoT, and Next-Generation Insurance Products
Evaluating AI Models and Making Sense of Analytics
Risk, Ethics, and Regulation in AI-Driven Insurance
Building the AI Business Case and Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of insurance operations and a keen interest in data and AI applications. No prior coding experience is required.
